column1: # Stage S5 D2, second of three: the ballistics files into the five crates, after
# s5_ballistics_folders.tsv moved the four module folders. Paths name the tree before these moves.
# ballistics_model: angular units and wind beside the catalog and flight model, with their tests
# the hand-written test catalog is a contract fixture every crate's tests read
# ballistics_solver: the solver module root becomes lib.rs; crest clearance and dispersion join it,
# with their tests and the symmetry and bounded-failure suites
# fire_mission_planning: the assembler, comparison, fuze, battery and wording, with their tests
# ballistics_calibration: the calibration module root becomes lib.rs; the digest tests pin the
# SHA-256 the catalog bytes are hashed with; the oracle suite joins the crate's tests
# ballistics_agreement_cases: the lattice of drawn cases and its tests
# the ballistics module README becomes the ballistics category README
